registration_scope: Private computational plan frozen after code/input preflight and inspection of published reference curves; not an external preregistration.
target: Partial replication of Benomar-Coester 2024 Figures2/3 and AppendixF class/decay sorting-comparison results, not a Dijkstra replication.
primary_estimand: Mean clean key comparisons per key over30 independent condition draws; head comparisons free; dirty counts reported separately. Advice/index/RNG/transport comparisons are outside original clean-count metric.

analysis_rules.curves: Publish every size/model/parameter cell, mean, sample and population SD, and95% bootstrap CI from our30replicates; original std never reinterpreted as standard error.
analysis_rules.agreement: All378pointwise errors; median/max absolute relative error per curve and RMSE divided by mean reference curve. PDF-derived plotted means distinguished from released n1000 aggregates and raw trials.
claims: Report class c=0-to-n endpoint changes plus full curves; no adjacent-step monotonicity requirement.
Report decay t=0-to-max endpoint changes plus full curves; no adjacent-step monotonicity requirement.
Report every cell relative to author analytic BH formula and crossover intervals; no claimallpredictionqualitiesbeatBH.
Report online/offline and dirty/offline paired ratios descriptively; no arbitrary equivalence interpretation of comparable.
analysis_rules.inference: Qualitative claim-specific supported/unsupported/indeterminate assessments with explicit scope, not one automatic success score or universal speed claim.
analysis_rules.failures: Preserve all conditions, validation errors and interruptions. No outcome-based exclusions or retuned parameters.

departures: Independent C++implementation, validated against originalPythonon666smallshared traces.
Exact-in-ideal-law multinomial sampling of final decay ranks, with declared floating-PRNG differences.
Primary sorting counts only on the Mac; previous two-host native timings and retention are separate extensions.
publication_reference_note: One Figure2 n100000 heap line differs from the released analytic formula by0.0003104comparisons/key; retain it as a published plot/reference discrepancy. Vector ticks independently calibrate the axis.
